_meta.rule: HOTLINES: NEVER add or edit a hotline/text-line number without a human verifying it against an authoritative source (source=national_verified, verified=true). EMERGENCY numbers (police/ambulance/fire): emitted only under the owner's cited-sources standard of 2026-10-29 — >=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official, source=multi_source_cited (CIRISAgent#1248). A wrong crisis number is catastrophically worse than the directory fallback.

verification_notes: No human-verified national hotline entries for this locale yet — international directories only. See CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md before adding entries; numbers require human verification (verified=true) against an authoritative source. Emergency (police/ambulance/fire) numbers for IN, LK, SG added 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248): 6 of 9 meet the owner's cited-sources standard (source=multi_source_cited, emitted); the rest are staged verified=false and NOT emitted — see CRISIS_RESOURCES_VERIFICATION_NEEDED.md.

Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in India Telephone: 112 (ambulance, fire, police) These services provide support in English, Hindi and additional languages" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | AOSP eccdata (Android's emergency-number database): IN 112 types ['AMBULANCE', 'FIRE', 'POLICE']. emergency_sri_lanka_1990.name: Emergency services
emergency_sri_lanka_1990.validation_notes: CITED 2026-10-29 (CIRISAgent#1248) under the owner's cited-sources standard (>=2 independent agreeing sources, >=1 official; no human check). Sources: UK FCDO travel advice: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Sri Lanka Ambulance: 011 2691111 or 1990 Fire and Rescue: 111 Police: 118/119 Emergency Police Mobile Squad: 011 5717171 Tourist Police: 011 2421052" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API) | 1990 Suwa Seriya Foundation (statutory body, 1990 Suwaseriya Foundation Act No. 18 of 2018) (non-official): "the very first 1990 ambulance was launched in Hambantota on July 27, 2016 ... the "1990 Suwa Seriya" free ambulance service has become a proud pioneer in Sri Lanka" (https://www.1990.lk/?p=13). Sources agree it reaches: ambulance. Conflict resolved 2026-10-29 by owner-directed second-opinion review (not human verification); FCDO said ambulance 1990 (or 011 2691111), fire and rescue 111, police 118/119, Wikipedia said ambulance/fire 110, police 119. This number's provenance: FCDO. UK FCDO page checked: https://www.gov.uk/foreign-travel-advice/sri-lanka/getting-help (fetched 2026-10-29); page text: UK FCDO travel advice, Getting help: "Emergency services in Sri Lanka Ambulance: 011 2691111 or 1990 Fire and Rescue: 111 Police: 118/119 Emergency Police Mobile Squad: 011 5717171 Tourist Police: 011 2421052" (fetched 2026-10-29 via gov.uk content API). Cross-check (not a source): en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_emergency_telephone_numbers — wikipedia does not list 1990; lists 110 for ambulance/fire.
